{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
'''''Egale''''' was a [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|Nebulon-B frigate]] used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. The ''Egale'' arrived too late to stop an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] capture operation on one of two [[Ton-Falk-class escort carrier|Escort Carriers]] [[Prowler (escort carriers)|''Prowler'']]. The frigate launched multiple fighters such as [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wings]] and [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]] but the fighters along with the frigate were destroyed by two [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE Defenders]].
